meaning.REFUSED: the source refuses PROPX's runner (HTTP 401 / 403 / 429) — recorded, never worked around; the last valid data is kept
meaning.FAILING: the latest check failed or found an unrecognised shape — the last valid data is kept and dated
meaning.CHECK_STALE: PROPX's last good check is older than the lane's cadence allows
meaning.SOURCE_STALE: PROPX checks on schedule, but the source's own content is older than its documented lag (or the source is classified stale)
meaning.EXPECTED_LAG: a newer period is due under the documented lag, and its window has not closed yet
meaning.CURRENT: checked on schedule and the source holds the newest period its documented lag allows
meaning.DATED_BUILD: no scheduled check — a dated build or a hand transcription; its date is shown
